title: Choose the visual world for the Admin app
question: The roll assigned Duplicate Forms. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Logo and the forest-green + lime palette stay in every option.

options.label: Duplicate Forms
options.lineage: Portuguese pre-printed duplicate pads: guias, faturas, talões
options.thesis: Every record is a numbered form: boxed fields, its number top-right, its state stamped on it.
options.viewport: Left index like a pad's tab dividers; orders ledger of form stubs, ENC number in mono, boxed columns, state as a stamp.
options.risk: Becomes costume if stamps get rotated or grungy; must stay crisp, flat and 1px.

raised.raise: State restyles a row in place; columns never move or reflow.
Every rule is one device pixel; states are printed marks: outline at rest, filled when done, struck when cancelled.
Every code (ENC-1048, ref, NIF) is itself the link to its record.
'Precisa de ti' weight follows one fixed ramp, never ad-hoc colour.
Quantity buckets always visibly sum to the line qty, like tape time to a side.

options.label: Tabela de Preços
options.thesis: The admin set like the price tables staff read all year: brand section bands, dense ruled tables, page folios.
options.viewport: Green band header per section, a dense ruled table under it, totals right-aligned like PVP columns.
options.risk: Familiar: close to what a well-made data-table admin already is.

options.label: High-density Modules
options.thesis: A whole order desk on one screen: hairline modules, each with a small header tab.
options.viewport: Order page as a packed CSS-grid mosaic: lines, payment, documents, log as tabbed modules edge to edge.
options.case: Wins on density for all-day desk work; loses on audience identification (nothing in Climaeco's world).
options.risk: Tiring and cramped if type drops below 12px.

options.label: Split-flap Board
options.thesis: Orders as departures ranked by time.
options.case: Fuses poorly: dark board fights the green brand and reads as novelty.
options.kept: Rows never reflow on state change.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.case: Fuses poorly: no spatial data to chart.

options.label: Event Catalog
options.thesis: Codes and positions as one space.
options.case: Fuses poorly: staff work in records, not thumbnails.

options.label: Cassette J-card
options.case: Fuses poorly: handwriting undermines trust in money figures.

options.label: Centre-rail Setting
options.thesis: Hairline ruling engine and printed state marks.
options.viewport: Two columns around a key rail.
options.case: Fuses poorly: book measure is too slow for a desk.
options.kept: One-device-pixel rules; states as printed marks.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A Linear/Stripe-grade admin: left sidebar, neutral surfaces, the green as the one accent.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar nav, page title row, filter bar, crisp table.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from any other well-made admin by design.
